definitions.explanation: A multi-story structure, typically for commercial use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ビル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}った→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ビル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The company is in a building in front of the station.
The office is on the 5th floor of this building.

notes:
ビル is a loanword from English "building," typically referring to multi-story commercial buildings.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ビル: tall building
- ⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧ビル: office building
- ビル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧5⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧: 5th floor of the building
- ビル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋上|おくじょう}→屋上：01341_okujou⟧: building rooftop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ビル: commercial/office building (loanword)
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: building (general, native word)
- ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧: apartment building (residential)
- ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧ビル: high-rise building

USAGE:
ビル typically implies a concrete/steel commercial structure. Residential buildings are more commonly called ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧ or ⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧.
